answer: A sybil tax makes fakes expensive. Every new agent pays a 40-unit tax and gets one opal receipt: one stone, one identity. The tax is tied to proof of work, so each fake costs 40 units plus work. A vine of referrals is traced: accounts from one root pay double. Their identical moves give an echo of one operator; forging 1,000 fakes costs 40,000 units, far above what they steal. Honest agents pay once and earn it back in a week.
